bugs.error_message: New index query tests referenced nonexistent StoredSnapshot.snapshot_version; Ruff found two overlong test lines and initial CLI/query formatting differences.

bugs.error_message: Normal-sandbox docker info reported Docker config access denied and permission denied on the docker_engine pipe despite the local daemon being available.

bugs.error_message: codex --version warned 'Could not find home directory' while reporting a version; no Claude command was found on PATH.

bugs.error_message: Offline evaluation tests initially failed with INVALID_LIMIT because database_overview was called with 100; mypy rejected len() on object-typed packet values and an untyped monkeypatch wrapper, while Ruff found line/layout issues.

bugs.error_message: Native-Windows codex sandbox probes with a custom workspace-only profile and built-in :read-only profile produced no command output and did not complete within the observation window.

The enclosing workspace sandbox also prevents ordinary nested sandbox initialization (no home dir); a model-free echo succeeds with scoped outer escalation.

bugs.error_message: Isolated package build failed with WinError 5 when writing .pytest-tmp/releasecheck-transitive-dist under scoped elevated execution.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated isolated build process could download Hatchling but could not create the chosen .pytest-tmp output path under this workspace's ACLs.
bugs.fix: Rebuilt into the project-local .venv directory, verified both archives and a clean-wheel Codex/Claude MCP smoke, then removed only the exact disposable build and smoke directories after path validation.

bugs.error_message: The first WSL Codex sandbox profile hid Codex's own standalone binary; an inline absolute-path permission override then failed TOML permission parsing, and the first Windows-to-WSL copy path was denied.

bugs.error_message: The WSL evaluation virtual environment could not be created because ensurepip was unavailable; the first apt attempt also found the dpkg lock held by unattended-upgrades.

bugs.fix: Waited for unattended-upgrades to release the lock without killing it, installed python3-venv, and then created the dedicated runtime successfully.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell and Bash interpreted Markdown backticks in the baseline prompt as shell syntax, attempted to run the quoted identifiers, and removed them before Codex received the prompt.
bugs.root_cause: The prompt was embedded directly in a layered PowerShell-to-WSL shell command with unescaped backticks instead of being transported as literal data.
bugs.fix: Marked the otherwise correct baseline answer protocol-invalid, retained its metrics only as invalid-run evidence, and established a rule to use plain identifiers or a prompt file/stdin transport for future runs.

bugs.error_message: The corrected Graphit Codex arm exceeded the enclosing output capture context and ended without creating its requested final-answer file.
bugs.root_cause: Not established. The ephemeral run left no persisted transcript or usage summary, no active process remained, and the final output file was absent.
bugs.fix: Counted the attempt as a failed/unanalyzable pilot sample, did not invent tool or token metrics, and stopped before any replacement model call because one-per-arm authorization was exhausted.

bugs.error_message: Layered inline PowerShell-to-WSL diagnostic commands failed with unmatched-quote and truncated Python string syntax errors.

bugs.fix: Switched to direct argument-only WSL commands and a short apply_patch-created read-only helper, then deleted the helper after inspection.

bugs.error_message: The first replacement runner stopped before model use because the isolated workspace was not a Git repository and --skip-git-repo-check was absent; a preceding FK preflight also passed the table as a nonexistent --table option.
bugs.file: WSL corrected-pilot runner and Graphit CLI preflight

bugs.fix: Confirmed the transcript was zero bytes, added --skip-git-repo-check to both matched runners, used the documented positional CLI form, and then completed exactly one real replacement call per arm.

bugs.error_message: The first apply_patch import of pilot JSONL inserted blank lines between events and changed byte hashes through Windows line-ending normalization.
bugs.root_cause: Captured command output already contained line separators and the dynamic patch generator added an extra separator; the Windows workspace also normalizes text line endings.

bugs.error_message: Initial compact-profile test and documentation patches failed context verification, and Ruff requested mechanical formatting in codex.py.

bugs.error_message: A --no-isolation package build could not import hatchling; the first full-pytest capture ended without its completion event, and cleanup could not read or remove the installed-wheel target's bin directory ACL.

bugs.fix: Used an approved isolated build, reran pytest in a tracked session to exit 0, verified the wheel from a separate target, removed both archive directories, and retained/documented only the partially cleaned target instead of forcing ACL ownership.

bugs.error_message: The first model-free compact MCP check passed -p after the mcp list subcommand, which rejected the profile option as unexpected.

bugs.error_message: The first checksum-generation command used [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath, which is unavailable in the installed Windows PowerShell/.NET surface.

bugs.error_message: The first checksum verifier resolved manifest entries from the repository root and failed to find aggregate.json.

bugs.fix: Resolved every manifest entry against the manifest's parent directory and verified all 17 hashes successfully.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-bundle test rejected the valid 114-table overview because entry_tables_truncated is true above the bounded 50-table overview page; Ruff also requested a one-line signature.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-packet proxy-token measurement attempted a blocked network fetch for o200k_base.
bugs.root_cause: The command did not point tiktoken at the repository's already-cached encoding file.
bugs.fix: Rerun with TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR set explicitly to .cache/tiktoken; do not request network access because the validated cache is available.

bugs.error_message: The first combined documentation patch failed because an AGENT_EVALUATION context line was matched in the wrong section.
bugs.root_cause: The large patch assumed nearby text that was actually separated by the measurements section.
bugs.fix: Re-read the exact ranges and applied smaller file-scoped patches; no partial change occurred from the failed patch.

bugs.error_message: The first approved scaled-bundle preparation could not create a child under .pytest-tmp, and PowerShell continued into dependent hash commands after the native command failed.
bugs.root_cause: The pytest-managed directory has an incompatible Windows ACL for this process, and the orchestration command did not set ErrorActionPreference or explicitly stop on the native exit code.
bugs.fix: Use a fresh explicit bundle path directly under the writable workspace, set ErrorActionPreference to Stop, and check LASTEXITCODE immediately after native commands. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first WSL arm-copy command ended with an unmatched quote before executing.
bugs.root_cause: PowerShell expanded Bash-style dollar-prefixed variables inside the double-quoted bash -lc payload before Bash parsed it.
bugs.fix: Avoid cross-shell variables and rerun with explicit, single-quoted paths in a PowerShell literal payload. The parse failure occurred before workspace creation or model use.

bugs.error_message: The relative-path WSL copy succeeded, but its trailing stat command lost the quoted format argument and exited before the file listing.
bugs.root_cause: Windows-to-WSL argument translation again stripped nested quotes in the bash -lc payload; the mutating copy steps had already completed successfully and hashes were printed.
bugs.fix: Use quote-free wc/find validation commands for the remaining preflight and avoid nested formatted arguments. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled-arm Codex sandbox preflight loaded profile file pilot but omitted the required explicit --permission-profile argument.
bugs.root_cause: codex sandbox distinguishes the configuration profile (-p pilot) from the named permissions profile (-P pilot), unlike codex exec which resolves default_permissions from the loaded profile.
bugs.fix: Add -P pilot to every model-free sandbox probe and rerun both own-readable and sibling-invisible checks. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The direct Windows-to-WSL codex mcp get preflight stripped TOML array quotes, so Codex parsed mcp_servers.graphit.args as a string instead of a sequence.
bugs.root_cause: Nested TOML quoting did not survive direct PowerShell/WSL argument translation, although the copied POSIX runner file retains the correct literal arguments.
bugs.fix: Create a short apply_patch-managed POSIX preflight script with the exact runner overrides, copy it into WSL, and execute it there. No model call was made.

bugs.error_message: The first scaled evidence diagnostic printed the baseline packet embedded in JSONL and was display-truncated; the dynamic apply_patch import also added one extra terminal newline to each file.
bugs.root_cause: Grep selected the full command result instead of only event metadata, and the patch generator represented an existing terminal newline as an extra empty added line.
bugs.fix: Validate JSONL with a structured parser, then re-import each raw file after removing exactly one terminal newline before apply_patch adds its canonical newline. Record repository-copy hashes separately.

bugs.error_message: Visualization inspection attempted to read nonexistent src/graphit/graph_projection.py.
bugs.root_cause: The graph projection filename was inferred instead of located first; GraphProjection is defined in graph_export.py.

bugs.error_message: Focused interactive-HTML tests passed, but Ruff reported unsorted standard-library imports in graph_html.py and test_graph_html.py.

bugs.error_message: openwolf sync could not launch through openwolf.ps1 because the Windows PowerShell execution policy disables scripts.

bugs.error_message: The installed OpenWolf CLI rejected the documented sync subcommand as unknown.
bugs.root_cause: This installed OpenWolf version exposes a different command surface than the project guidance assumed.
bugs.fix: Inspect openwolf.cmd --help and use the supported non-network anatomy refresh command rather than guessing or editing generated hashes manually.

bugs.error_message: openwolf scan --check reported anatomy out of date immediately after two successful full scans.
bugs.root_cause: The installed OpenWolf check appears to compare state that its own scan output changes or otherwise disagrees with the just-written index; the refreshed graph_html description and symbols are present.
bugs.fix: Retained the successfully regenerated 158-file anatomy, verified the changed entries directly, recorded the CLI incompatibility, and stopped repeating the non-converging check.

bugs.error_message: Copyright-package focused tests passed, but Ruff requested two formatting changes and mypy rejected reusing notice_path as both pathlib.Path and wheel member str.
bugs.root_cause: The NOTICE validation patch reused one variable name across filesystem and archive namespaces and differed from Ruff's canonical wrapping.
bugs.fix: Separated repository_notice_path from wheel_notice_path and applied the requested formatting before rerunning all focused gates.

bugs.error_message: The first attribution artifact build failed while build decoded isolated pip subprocess output as UTF-8; byte 0xfe caused UnicodeDecodeError before any artifact was produced.
bugs.root_cause: The build frontend and Windows pip subprocess disagreed on output encoding while bootstrapping Hatchling in a temporary isolated environment; this is not a project source or metadata validation failure.
bugs.fix: Install the declared Hatchling backend into the disposable development venv and run the same PEP 517 build with --no-isolation, then validate the artifacts independently.

bugs.error_message: The first Hatchling installation attempt exhausted retries because sandboxed network access to the package index was blocked.
bugs.root_cause: Hatchling was not cached as an installed package and the default sandbox denies external package-index connections.
bugs.fix: Repeated the exact scoped pip install with user-approved network escalation; Hatchling 1.32.4 and its missing backend dependencies installed successfully.

bugs.error_message: scripts/smoke_installed.py --help failed because the script has no command-line parser and detected Graphit from the source tree.
bugs.root_cause: The packaging smoke script was mistakenly treated as a CLI with a help flag; it is intended to run without arguments under the interpreter of an isolated wheel installation.
bugs.fix: Read the script and CI invocation, then use a disposable virtual environment containing the built wheel and invoke the script without arguments.

bugs.error_message: The first disposable wheel smoke environment lacked mcp, psycopg, and typer, so pip check and executable startup failed.
bugs.root_cause: A virtual environment created by another virtual environment still inherits only the base Python's global site packages; --system-site-packages did not expose the parent development venv dependencies, and the wheel was intentionally installed with --no-deps.
bugs.fix: Install the wheel normally with its declared runtime dependencies inside the disposable environment before rerunning the smoke test.

bugs.error_message: The escalated dependency installation could not execute the disposable environment's python.exe and returned Windows UnauthorizedAccessException.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated execution boundary could not access the workspace-created nested virtual-environment executable, despite normal sandbox execution being able to use it.
bugs.fix: Avoid elevation for this disposable executable; expose the already-installed development dependencies through a local .pth file while keeping Graphit itself installed from the built wheel.

bugs.error_message: The local dependency bridge made pip check pass but MCP startup could not import pywintypes.
bugs.root_cause: Adding the parent venv's site-packages directory does not recursively process its pywin32.pth, so pywin32's win32, win32/lib, pythonwin, and bootstrap entries were absent.
bugs.fix: Mirror the exact local pywin32.pth paths and bootstrap import in the disposable environment's dependency bridge, without changing product source or package metadata.

bugs.error_message: The first combined attribution-documentation patch failed on an ADR-057 context mismatch.
bugs.root_cause: The large multi-file patch expected a different line break around ADR-057 than the current document contained.
bugs.fix: Confirmed the failed patch made no partial changes, reread the exact section, and applied smaller targeted patches.

bugs.error_message: The combined final gate invoked scripts/check_dist.py with an unsupported --dist-dir argument, so the script checked the stale default dist directory and rejected its older source archive.
bugs.root_cause: check_dist.py exposes check_distributions(root, dist_dir) as a Python function but its __main__ block has no argument parser and always selects root/dist.
bugs.fix: Build the current candidate into a fresh explicit directory and call check_distributions with that exact Path from Python.

bugs.error_message: Temporary cleanup preflight tried to resolve an already-removed .pytest-tmp attribution smoke environment and then called StartsWith on a null path.
bugs.root_cause: The full pytest run had already cleaned the shared .pytest-tmp contents after the installed-wheel smoke completed.
bugs.fix: Treat the absent smoke environment as already cleaned and remove only the two existing artifact directories whose resolved workspace containment was verified.

bugs.error_message: The web reader returned an internal cache-miss error while opening the supplied GitHub repository URL.
bugs.root_cause: The web fetch path could not populate the GitHub page from its cache.
bugs.fix: Verified the repository directly with read-only git ls-remote instead.

bugs.error_message: The sandboxed git ls-remote could not connect to github.com:443.
bugs.root_cause: Default sandbox networking blocks direct GitHub access.
bugs.fix: Repeated the exact read-only ls-remote with scoped network approval; it succeeded and returned no refs, confirming an empty repository.

bugs.error_message: Adding origin first failed on sandbox .git/config permissions, then elevated Git rejected the repository as dubious ownership.
bugs.root_cause: The workspace .git directory is owned by the sandbox identity while elevated Git runs as the desktop user.
bugs.fix: Used a command-local safe.directory setting with scoped approval, avoiding any global Git configuration change; origin was added successfully.

bugs.error_message: Repository-URL distribution tests and Ruff checks passed, but Ruff format requested one single-line generator expression in check_dist.py.
bugs.root_cause: The initial patch wrapped a short sorted generator more broadly than Ruff's canonical formatter.
bugs.fix: Apply Ruff formatting to the affected file and repeat the focused gates.

bugs.error_message: Initial staging emitted Windows LF-to-CRLF warnings and git diff --cached --check reported terminal blank lines, including immutable evaluation evidence.
bugs.root_cause: The new repository had no Git attributes despite an LF editor policy, and raw evidence intentionally preserves exact hashed bytes that can violate generic whitespace checks.
bugs.fix: Add repository LF attributes, remove two non-evidence terminal blank lines, and disable whitespace normalization/checking only for exact captured evidence so published checksums remain valid.

bugs.error_message: GitHub CLI status checks failed because gh is not installed on this Windows environment.
bugs.root_cause: The repository was pushed through Git credential support, but the separate gh executable is absent from PATH.
bugs.fix: Use GitHub's read-only REST API for repository, run, job, and check status without installing another tool.

bugs.error_message: The first public GitHub CI run passed Python 3.11-3.14 tests but failed its combined isolated-wheel smoke step; unauthenticated job-log download returned HTTP 403 admin required.
bugs.root_cause: The workflow combined wheel installation, pip/CLI checks, and init/MCP smoke into one shell step, while the public API exposed only its aggregate exit code and not the authenticated log.
bugs.fix: Split the smoke workflow into separately named install, package/CLI, and init/MCP steps so the next public check identifies the exact failing boundary without reading credentials.

bugs.error_message: A local WSL reproduction probe found Python 3.12 and venv support but no pip module or uv executable.
bugs.root_cause: The existing WSL environment was prepared for isolated Codex evaluation, not Python package building.
bugs.fix: Avoid changing the WSL system solely for diagnosis; improve CI step granularity and use its public job/step results first.

bugs.error_message: The second public CI run proved wheel installation and CLI checks pass, but installed init/MCP smoke fails on Ubuntu.
bugs.root_cause: local_mcp_launch resolved sys.executable. POSIX venv Python is a symlink, so resolution escaped .package-smoke to the base interpreter where Graphit was not installed; Windows venv executables did not expose this.
bugs.fix: Use the absolute active interpreter path without dereferencing symlinks, update launcher expectations, and add a symlink regression test before rerunning installed-wheel CI.

bugs.error_message: The first combined MCP launcher fix patch failed because the expected docs/MCP.md sentence came from docs/TESTING.md instead.
bugs.root_cause: A cross-file documentation phrase was applied as patch context in the wrong document.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes, applied the code/tests independently, then reread and patched the exact MCP and decision sections.

bugs.error_message: The web reader returned cache-miss errors for the graphit-db PyPI JSON and project URLs.
bugs.root_cause: The web fetch path could not populate these uncached PyPI endpoints.
bugs.fix: Queried the official PyPI JSON API directly with read-only network approval; it returned HTTP 404 for graphit-db.

bugs.error_message: The first direct PyPI JSON request could not connect inside the default sandbox.
bugs.root_cause: Default sandbox networking blocks direct PyPI access.
bugs.fix: Repeated only the official read-only endpoint with scoped network approval; graphit-db was absent at the check time.

bugs.error_message: The first combined release-documentation patch failed because the expected README release-readiness lines wrapped differently.
bugs.root_cause: A large multi-file patch used stale README line wrapping after earlier absolute-link edits.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes, applied workflow/docs separately, reread the exact README range, and patched it narrowly.

bugs.error_message: The first combined public-PyPI smoke wrapper stayed active after package, pip-check, and version output, and a Win32_Process diagnostic query was denied.
bugs.root_cause: The combined install, smoke, and recursive cleanup command did not expose stage boundaries, so delayed Windows cleanup was indistinguishable from an MCP hang; sandboxed CIM inspection was unavailable.
bugs.fix: Interrupted the wrapper, added flushed stage labels to the reusable installed smoke, reran the installed artifact directly, observed every init/Codex/Claude MCP stage pass in 9 seconds, then validated and removed the temporary environment separately.

bugs.error_message: The first combined post-release evidence patch failed because docs/TESTING.md wrapped 'The same gate' on the preceding line.
bugs.root_cause: Patch context was reconstructed from a truncated earlier output instead of the exact final lines.
bugs.fix: Confirmed the first patch made no partial changes, reread the exact tail, and applied a narrowly matched patch.

bugs.error_message: git add/commit failed with 'Unable to create .git/index.lock: Permission denied'.
bugs.root_cause: The managed workspace permits source writes but exposes .git as read-only inside the default sandbox.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no files were staged or committed and repeated the exact scoped Git add/commit operation with elevated repository-write approval.

bugs.error_message: Elevated Git add/commit rejected the repository as dubious ownership because .git is owned by the sandbox identity.
bugs.root_cause: The scoped elevated command runs as Onur Parapan while the repository metadata was created by CodexSandboxOffline, activating Git's ownership guard.
bugs.fix: Avoid changing global Git configuration; pass the exact workspace as a command-local safe.directory value for the scoped add, commit, status, and push operations.

bugs.error_message: A PowerShell rg command split an alternation pattern containing pipes into path arguments and returned invalid-path errors.
bugs.root_cause: The regex argument was not kept as one shell-safe literal in the composed inspection command.
bugs.fix: Used simpler separately quoted searches and direct targeted file reads; do not pass unprotected regex pipes through PowerShell command strings.

bugs.error_message: User reported that graphit init does not automatically connect to project databases, scan all relationships, show a whole ERP diagram, or make that context available to Codex and Claude as expected.
bugs.file: src/graphit/cli.py; src/graphit/project.py; graph export and agent setup workflow

bugs.fix: Reclassify zero-configuration onboarding and whole-database ERP/ERD plus automatic project-local MCP wiring as the primary product goal; implement it through secret-safe discovery, orchestrated scan, full bounded projection, and agent setup slices.

bugs.error_message: The first discovery slice passed behavior tests but failed Ruff formatting/line length and strict mypy on reuse of a dict-inferred loop variable as Mapping.
bugs.root_cause: One local name was reused for dotenv dictionaries and the later generic Mapping iteration; initial patch formatting also differed from Ruff's canonical output.
bugs.fix: Renamed the dotenv-local value to preserve the declared Mapping type and ran the repository formatter before repeating focused tests and quality gates.

bugs.error_message: The first credential-reference patch was rejected because it targeted scanners/postgresql.py in two separate update operations.

bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes and split the work so each file is targeted once per patch.

bugs.error_message: The first store-test update patch failed because its final context accidentally contained 'assert assert'.
bugs.root_cause: A manually composed patch context included a duplicated keyword that was not present in the file.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes and reapplied only the four exact version lines with narrow context.

bugs.error_message: The first multi-document verified-source patch failed because the expected CLI source-test sentence wrapped differently.
bugs.root_cause: A broad patch used reconstructed line wrapping instead of the exact CLI text.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes, reread the narrow CLI/README ranges, and split documentation updates into exact smaller patches.

bugs.error_message: The elevated commit command's preliminary plain 'git diff --check' reported not-a-repository/dubious ownership help before the command-local-safe add and commit succeeded.
bugs.root_cause: The known command-local safe.directory option was applied to add/commit/status/log but omitted from the first Git segment running as the owner identity.
bugs.fix: Relied on the already successful sandbox diff check, retained the valid commit, logged the diagnostic mistake, and require command-local safe.directory on every elevated Git segment going forward.

bugs.error_message: A diagnostic rg regex for fake PostgreSQL rows was malformed by over-escaped parentheses and returned 'unclosed group'.
bugs.root_cause: A complex alternation was unnecessarily escaped inside a PowerShell command string.
bugs.fix: Repeated the search with a simple single-quoted alternation and used the returned exact line locations.

bugs.error_message: The first init-scan documentation patch failed because the expected architecture paragraph wrapped differently.
bugs.file: README.md; docs/CLI.md; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; related contracts and .wolf state
bugs.root_cause: A broad multi-file patch used approximate architecture line wrapping.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial changes and split the exact README/CLI/security/operating updates from a separately located architecture insertion.

bugs.error_message: A targeted rg inspection included tests/test_init.py, which does not exist, and rg returned an OS file-not-found error.
bugs.root_cause: The init test filename was inferred instead of first being resolved from the anatomy index or rg --files.
bugs.fix: Kept the valid search results and will resolve exact test filenames with rg --files before subsequent targeted reads.

bugs.error_message: The database HTML renderer patch inserted render_database_html before the existing render_html body was complete, leaving the original renderer body unreachable after the new function's return.
bugs.root_cause: The patch anchor matched the first closing expression inside render_html instead of the function's end.
bugs.fix: Replace the entire renderer tail from render_html onward so the neighborhood and database renderers each have a complete independent body.

bugs.error_message: The first renderer-tail repair patch did not apply because Unicode punctuation in the expected block was displayed with a different mojibake sequence.
bugs.root_cause: A broad deletion hunk included encoding-sensitive text instead of narrow ASCII-only anchors.
bugs.fix: Apply the restoration and deletion as separate narrow patches using ASCII-only boundary context.

bugs.error_message: The first multi-file OpenWolf state update did not apply because an approximate cerebrum context line was not present verbatim.
bugs.root_cause: One broad patch mixed exact state updates with a reconstructed Key Learnings anchor.
bugs.fix: Confirmed the patch was atomic and split memory, cerebrum, and status updates into narrow exact-context patches.

bugs.error_message: The first init-agent test patch did not apply because it combined two non-adjacent test contexts into one hunk.
bugs.root_cause: The no-agents test had been formatter-expanded and was not adjacent to the default-init assertions used by the same patch.
bugs.fix: Split the import, default agent configuration assertions, and no-agents behavior into separate exact-context patches.

bugs.error_message: The first multi-document init-agent contract patch did not apply because the README paragraph started mid-line relative to the reconstructed context.
bugs.root_cause: A broad patch again depended on approximate prose wrapping across several files.
bugs.fix: Confirmed no partial application and split README, CLI, and remaining contract updates into exact narrow patches.

bugs.error_message: The web open tool could not fetch the official PyPI 0.1.1 JSON endpoint and returned a cache-miss internal error.
bugs.root_cause: The browser connector did not make the uncached JSON endpoint accessible.
bugs.fix: Use a scoped read-only Invoke-RestMethod request to the official PyPI JSON API and distinguish HTTP 404 from other failures.

bugs.error_message: The isolated 0.1.1 build could not install Hatchling inside the sandbox, build then raised a UnicodeDecodeError while reporting pip output, and the semicolon-separated archive check ran despite the missing artifacts.
bugs.root_cause: Isolated build dependency download requires scoped network elevation on this Windows sandbox; PowerShell semicolons do not stop later commands after a nonzero native exit.
bugs.fix: Rerun only the build with scoped elevation, then run archive inspection as a separate command after successful artifacts exist.

bugs.error_message: The combined clean-wheel command printed Graphit 0.1.1 but produced no smoke stage output for over 100 seconds; a read-only Win32_Process CIM diagnostic was denied by the sandbox.
bugs.root_cause: The combined command obscured which process remained active, and the sandbox disallowed command-line process inspection.
bugs.fix: Interrupt the stalled combined session, verify its exit state, and rerun scripts/smoke_installed.py as a separate command with its existing flushed stage labels and bounded internal subprocess timeouts.

bugs.error_message: The elevated GitHub pre-release command authenticated gh successfully but its three plain git status/rev-parse/tag segments failed dubious-ownership checks.
bugs.root_cause: The known command-local safe.directory option was omitted from each elevated git segment.
bugs.fix: No release mutation occurred; rerun every git segment with command-local -c safe.directory and keep global Git configuration unchanged.

bugs.error_message: Immediately after successful Trusted Publishing, PyPI JSON exposed 0.1.1 but the public Simple Index still offered only 0.1.0; semicolon-separated pip check and graphit version commands then ran after the failed install.
bugs.root_cause: PyPI JSON/integrity and Simple Index propagation were briefly inconsistent, and PowerShell semicolons did not short-circuit the remaining verification stages.
bugs.fix: Wait for index propagation, retry only the exact public-index installation in the still-empty environment, then run dependency/version/smoke checks separately after install success.

bugs.error_message: The first post-release multi-file OpenWolf patch did not apply because the final init-agent STATUS sentence wrapped differently.
bugs.root_cause: A combined patch included one approximate STATUS prose anchor.
bugs.fix: Confirmed atomic rejection and split each OpenWolf state update into exact-context patches.

bugs.error_message: The first MSSQL/Oracle static-quality run found formatting, line-length, explicit re-export, and Oracle Literal typing errors.
bugs.root_cause: The initial multi-adapter slice was checked before repository formatting, and moving shared error classes made mypy require explicit compatibility exports.
bugs.fix: Format the new modules, add explicit PostgreSQL compatibility aliases, and type the Oracle relation-kind mapping as RelationKind before repeating all gates.

bugs.error_message: The focused compatibility suite had one stale test expecting the old PostgreSQL-only engine validation message.
bugs.root_cause: Source validation correctly widened to three engines, but the prior rejection-message assertion still encoded the single-engine contract.
bugs.fix: Update the assertion to require the explicit postgresql, mssql, or oracle engine allowlist.

bugs.error_message: The first multi-adapter focused suite had three test-fixture failures: Oracle identity case mismatch, an importlib monkeypatch leaking into pytest resolution, and an Oracle index query misclassified as a constraint query.
bugs.root_cause: The new tests used a PostgreSQL lowercase database fixture for Oracle, patched the shared importlib module without a nested context, and matched a nested ALL_CONSTRAINTS clause before the outer ALL_INDEXES clause.
bugs.fix: Use the exact Oracle service identity, scope the import failure patch, and classify the outer Oracle index query before its primary-constraint subquery.

bugs.error_message: The first combined fixture-fix patch did not apply because Ruff had collapsed the discovery test call onto one line.
bugs.root_cause: The patch used the pre-format multiline context instead of the exact formatter output.
bugs.fix: Reread the narrow ranges and apply the fixture corrections with exact post-format context.

bugs.error_message: The first repository quality run found two Ruff import issues and two strict-mypy fixture inference errors.
bugs.root_cause: Compatibility exports were ordered differently from Ruff's canonical import order, one test import became unused, and heterogeneous nested fixture literals inferred as object containers.
bugs.fix: Apply canonical import ordering, remove the unused import, and explicitly type the scripted database result containers.

bugs.error_message: The first multi-document adapter documentation patch did not apply because the README installation paragraph wrapped differently.
bugs.root_cause: A broad patch used an approximate README line break instead of the exact current prose.
bugs.fix: Reread the exact README ranges and split the documentation work into narrower exact-context patches.

bugs.error_message: The second combined documentation patch did not apply because the CLI TLS paragraph context was reconstructed with a different line break.
bugs.root_cause: The patch again coupled an exact architecture update to approximate CLI prose context.
bugs.fix: Apply architecture independently and use smaller exact CLI replacements.

bugs.error_message: The first engine-aware logical-key implementation would have changed PostgreSQL keys from the historical 'postgres:' namespace to 'postgresql:'.
bugs.root_cause: The new source engine value was used directly as a graph namespace without accounting for the pre-existing PostgreSQL compatibility contract.
bugs.fix: Centralize logical_namespace(), preserve 'postgres' for PostgreSQL, and use distinct 'mssql'/'oracle' namespaces in snapshots and review keys.

bugs.error_message: The operating/roadmap/testing documentation patch failed on an encoding-sensitive roadmap heading.
bugs.root_cause: The patch included a mojibake-rendered em dash in heading context.
bugs.fix: Remove the encoding-sensitive heading from the patch and update only exact ASCII prose anchors.

bugs.error_message: The ADR/readiness patch failed because the readiness table's rendered dash bytes differed from the patch context.
bugs.root_cause: The combined patch depended on an encoding-sensitive full table row.
bugs.fix: Append the ADR independently and update readiness using ASCII-only surrounding lines.

bugs.error_message: The 0.2.0 editable reinstall attempted isolated Hatchling download inside the restricted sandbox and failed; semicolon-separated checks and tests still ran afterward.
bugs.root_cause: pip build isolation creates a fresh environment and consults the package index even though Hatchling is already installed; PowerShell semicolons do not short-circuit native command failures.
bugs.fix: Repeat the editable reinstall as a separate command with --no-build-isolation --no-deps, then run package checks separately. The independently completed test suite passed 364 tests with five skips.

bugs.error_message: The no-build-isolation editable reinstall failed because Hatchling's editable helper package 'editables' is not installed in the development environment.
bugs.root_cause: The existing Hatchling backend can build regular wheels locally, but editable builds delegate to the separately packaged editables helper when isolation is disabled.
bugs.fix: Use the already-approved scoped network installation with normal build isolation for the final 0.2.0 editable metadata refresh instead of changing runtime project dependencies.

bugs.error_message: Running scripts/check_dist.py --help executed the checker because the script has no argument parser, then failed because 0.2.0 artifacts did not yet exist.
bugs.root_cause: The distribution checker is a fixed-entry script rather than a CLI with --help support.
bugs.fix: Build the 0.2.0 wheel and sdist into the expected dist directory first, then invoke the checker without arguments.

bugs.error_message: The wheel smoke rejected a --target installation because the package path was outside sys.prefix.
bugs.root_cause: scripts/smoke_installed.py intentionally requires the package to live inside the active interpreter prefix, so PYTHONPATH target injection is not a valid clean-install substitute.
bugs.fix: Create a dedicated temporary virtual environment, install the built wheel with dependencies there, and run the existing smoke under that interpreter.

bugs.error_message: The Windows py launcher could not resolve the requested -3.14 interpreter for the temporary wheel-smoke environment.
bugs.root_cause: The repository's working Python 3.14 interpreter is available through .venv, but not registered under the py launcher's requested selector in this sandbox.
bugs.fix: Create the temporary venv through the known .venv interpreter's stdlib venv module.

bugs.error_message: The elevated install could not execute the sandbox-created temporary venv interpreter and returned Windows UnauthorizedAccessException.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated owner identity cannot directly execute this sandbox-owned temporary interpreter even though it runs inside the default sandbox.
bugs.fix: Use the accessible repository venv's pip with pip --python targeting the temporary interpreter, retaining scoped network authority without directly launching the sandbox-owned executable outside the sandbox.

bugs.error_message: Elevated pip --python could not locate the temporary interpreter when given a relative workspace path.
bugs.root_cause: pip resolved the target interpreter under the elevated process context and did not accept the relative sandbox path.
bugs.fix: Retry the same scoped pip operation with the exact absolute target interpreter and wheel paths.

bugs.error_message: PowerShell parsed the quoted absolute Python executable path as a string and rejected the following -m token.
bugs.root_cause: A quoted executable path with spaces requires PowerShell's call operator.
bugs.fix: Invoke the quoted executable with '&' while keeping absolute target paths.

bugs.error_message: The temporary wheel smoke with parent-site PYTHONPATH failed to import pywintypes from MCP's Windows transport.
bugs.root_cause: Adding another environment's site-packages through PYTHONPATH does not process its pywin32 .pth file or DLL search path, so it is not equivalent to installing dependencies in the active venv.
bugs.fix: Create the final smoke venv under the established .venv package-smoke area with the elevated owner identity, then install the wheel and dependencies normally inside it.

bugs.error_message: The combined OpenWolf handoff patch failed on the encoding-sensitive 0.1.0-to-0.1.1 arrow in the prior STATUS goal.
bugs.root_cause: A broad state patch attempted to replace historical prose containing a Unicode arrow rendered differently by the shell.
bugs.fix: Keep the historical goal text, insert a clearly superseding current-goal block with ASCII anchors, and update each OpenWolf file separately.

bugs.error_message: The narrowed STATUS patch still failed because its section-heading anchor contained shell-rendered emoji mojibake.
bugs.root_cause: The heading itself was encoding-sensitive even after the historical arrow was removed from context.
bugs.fix: Anchor the current goal directly on the ASCII-only '**Goal:**' line and apply done/runtime updates as separate patches.

bugs.error_message: The sandboxed Docker availability probe could not read the user Docker config or connect to the engine pipe.
bugs.root_cause: Docker Desktop's user configuration and named pipe are outside the default workspace sandbox.
bugs.fix: Repeat read-only Docker inspection with scoped elevated Docker authority; server 29.1.2 is available and the SQL Server 2022 image is already cached.

bugs.error_message: The first SQL Server integration-test type check found no pyodbc stubs and referenced a nonexistent direct_relationships public function.
bugs.root_cause: pyodbc ships no typing metadata, and the local query service is named table_relationships. The fixture also initially attempted to bind a CREATE LOGIN password where SQL Server DDL does not accept that parameter form.
bugs.fix: Mark only the external pyodbc import as untyped, call table_relationships, and embed the fixture-generated restricted-character password in disposable setup DDL.

bugs.error_message: The SQL Server integration assertion used RelationshipDetail.constraint instead of its public name field.
bugs.root_cause: The scanner metadata calls the property constraint name conceptually, while the query DTO exposes it as name.
bugs.fix: Assert RelationshipDetail.name, matching the existing query contract.

bugs.error_message: The first elevated SQL Server integration run failed before test setup because pytest could not remove the sandbox-owned .pytest-tmp directory.
bugs.root_cause: The elevated owner identity and the default sandbox identity own different temporary trees; repository pytest config forced the shared sandbox-owned basetemp.
bugs.fix: Rerun only the integration test with an explicit fresh elevated-owned basetemp under the ignored .venv area.

bugs.error_message: The first real SQL Server adapter verification reached the disposable server but returned the sanitized CONNECTION_TIMEOUT/QUERY_TIMEOUT-class failure for the reader path.
bugs.root_cause: Graphit assigned the five-second query timeout to pyodbc.Cursor, which has no timeout attribute. The resulting AttributeError included the word 'timeout', so broad sanitization misclassified it as a network timeout.
bugs.fix: Assign query timeout on pyodbc.Connection, narrow timeout error matching, use the canonical tcp:host,port server form, and keep the permission check catalog-based. The complete live test then reached metadata mapping.

bugs.error_message: The first successful live SQL Server metadata read classified ordinary tables as views.
bugs.root_cause: sys.objects.type is a fixed-width char field and pyodbc returned ordinary table type as 'U ' rather than the unit fixture's idealized 'U'.
bugs.fix: Normalize fixed-width catalog discriminators with strip() before table-kind and constraint-kind mapping, and add the padded value to the unit fixture.

bugs.error_message: The Oracle readiness probe tried to render a missing Docker health-check field.
bugs.root_cause: The selected Oracle Free image does not define Docker HEALTHCHECK metadata.
bugs.fix: Read the bounded container startup log and wait for its explicit DATABASE IS READY TO USE marker instead.

bugs.error_message: Strict mypy rejected an unused import-not-found ignore on oracledb in the new integration test.
bugs.root_cause: python-oracledb includes sufficient typing metadata in the installed version, unlike pyodbc.
bugs.fix: Remove the unnecessary type-ignore comment and retain the typed import.

bugs.error_message: The first live Oracle test compared the returned lowercase service name with the configured uppercase service name.
bugs.root_cause: Oracle SYS_CONTEXT returned the service name with server-normalized casing; service names are case-insensitive for this assertion.
bugs.fix: Compare verified and configured service names with casefold while preserving the actual returned identity value.

bugs.error_message: A parallel quality-gate invocation yielded before the full pytest process completed; starting a second full suite caused overlapping repository-level tests and transient failures.
bugs.root_cause: The first 372-test process exceeded the tool's initial yield window and remained active while a diagnostic full suite was started. Some tests intentionally exercise fixed project-level configuration paths and are not safe across two simultaneous full-suite processes.
bugs.fix: Run at most one full pytest suite at a time, poll its session to completion, and parallelize only independent static checks. The isolated rerun passed 365 tests with seven expected skips.

bugs.error_message: The sandboxed isolated 0.2.0 build failed while installing Hatchling and python-build then raised a UnicodeDecodeError while rendering pip's Windows output.
bugs.root_cause: The isolated PEP 517 environment needed package-index access outside the default sandbox; python-build also assumed UTF-8 for the localized subprocess failure bytes.
bugs.fix: Rerun the same scoped python -m build command with approved dependency-download access. Fresh wheel and sdist then built successfully and passed archive and Twine checks.
